customManagers.description: Makefile defaults mirror the digest-pinned Dockerfile base images; make verify-pins fails if the two drift, so both are updated in the same PR (see the base image groups below).
Checksum-verified tool/runtime versions annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above (Dockerfile ARGs and their Makefile mirrors).

packageRules.description: Supply-chain inputs (actions, container images, bundled binaries) are always human-reviewed; label them for triage.
Org practice: automerge patch-level Go module updates once every check passes. platformAutomerge=false makes Renovate itself wait for all checks, independent of repo auto-merge settings.
Let new module, action and tool releases age before proposing them, so a compromised or yanked release is usually caught upstream first. Docker registries without timestamps are excluded.
Actions are pinned to full-semver tags, so a digest-only change means the tag was moved (the tj-actions pattern). Never a routine PR: require explicit approval on the dependency dashboard.
Kairos release tags are immutable; a digest-only update means the tag was re-pushed (kairos#4203). Require explicit approval.
prBodyNotes: Digest-only update of an immutable release tag: confirm the re-push with the Kairos maintainers before approving.

packageRules.description: Go toolchain: the go.mod go directive and the provider builder image (golang:*-alpine) must move together; make verify-pins fails on drift.

STATIC_BUILDER_IMAGE (plain golang tag) compiles upstream kubelet and containerd and tracks the Go minor upstream Kubernetes builds with: take patches only, move minors by hand (the kubelet-build stage fails if upstream's .go-version is newer).
